meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能处理基因组区间数据：检测重叠、生成覆盖度轨迹（WIG/BigWig）、为机器学习做基因组分词、管理参考序列（refget）以及处理单细胞片段等。
howto.when: 当你处理基因组区间（如 BED 文件）、覆盖度轨迹或重叠检测等任务，或为机器学习准备基因组数据时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can process genomic interval data: detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks (WIG/BigWig), tokenize genomic regions for ML, manage reference sequences via refget, and process single-cell fragments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with genomic intervals (e.g., BED files), coverage tracks, overlap detection, or preparing genomic data for machine learning.
